panels.visual: The Palamidi fortress on a cliff above Nafplio and its bay, many stone steps zigzagging up, sunny
panels.caption: The Palamidi fortress, built by the Venetians between about 1711 and 1714.

panels.visual: A tour guide with a flag saying '999 steps!' pointing up, tourists with sweaty faces, sun hats
panels.caption: Everyone says there are 999 steps.

panels.visual: A boy counting steps with a clicker, a sweat drop, a long staircase going up out of frame
panels.caption: People who actually counted get different numbers.

panels.visual: Several people each holding a number sign: 850, 920, 999, 1,000, arguing, Glauka looking amused
panels.caption: Usually between about 850 and 1,000, depending on where you start and stop.
